name: Human Head of Ras Frostwhisper
shortDescription: Human Head of Ras Frostwhisper, represented in the Ras Frostwhisper research story.
body: The quest objective returned to Marduke after Ras is made mortal and killed. The respectful wrapped image is symbolic and non-graphic. The image is an original interpretive illustration, not canonical game art or proof of exact costume, body, location, or simultaneous presence.  See docs/research/ras-frostwhisper-production.md and docs/research/ras-frostwhisper-visual-assets.json.
